title: Token-Based Billing Model Transition
description: GitHub transitioned all Copilot subscribers from request-based billing (PRUs) to usage-based token-based billing starting June 1, 2026. The new system calculates usage on input, output, and cached tokens with a $20/user minimum spend requirement.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot's new credit-based pricing is highway robbery. My projected bill next month... $847 per month
Users reported cost increases of 10-22x compared to the previous pricing model

title: Visual Studio May 2026 Update
description: GitHub announced the May 2026 update for GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026, introducing a new Plan agent for better project planning, Skills panel for enhanced functionality, multi-file change summaries, and better chat context.

title: Gemini CLI Shutdown and Antigravity CLI Replacement
description: Google announced the complete shutdown of Gemini CLI scheduled for June 18, 2026, with all requests returning HTTP 410 errors. The tool is being replaced by Antigravity CLI, a closed-source Go-based rewrite announced at Google I/O 2026.

community_feedback.quote: Antigravity CLI, per the name, seems to be positioning it as a replacement for Gemini CLI
The transition affects all CLI workflows and could break CI/CD pipelines if not addressed

title: Enhanced MCP Support and Streamlined Editing
description: Continue.dev released a significant update on June 13, 2026, featuring enhanced Model Context Protocol (MCP) support and a streamlined editing workflow where Edit mode is no longer a separate selectable mode.

title: 2026 Release with Enterprise Features
description: Devin released updates in 2026 including enterprise features and developer productivity improvements. The Desktop changangelog notes an update to bundled Devin Local agent version 2026.5.26, which is now aware of files users have open. Classic environment settings will be deprecated on June 30, 2026.

community_feedback.quote: Cognition's Scott Wu says AI coding agents shouldn't replace humans

title: June 2026 Component Styling and Chart Customization
description: Cursor released updates on June 3, 2026, including improved component styling and added chart customization functionality, along with Organizations-related features.

title: v0.77.0 Language Support Expansion
description: Aider released version v0.77.0 with a major upgrade adding 130 new programming languages with linter support via tree-sitter-language-pack, expanding support to over 100 languages total.

title: Rate Limit Changes and Model Updates
description: Anthropic announced changes to Claude Code rate limits in May 2026, following 6 months of restrictions. The platform also released Claude Opus 4.7 with improvements in software engineering and complex coding tasks.

title: Wave 3 Updates and Enhanced Features
description: Windsurf released Wave 3 updates including better credit tracking, revamped Turbo Mode, and customizable app icons for Mac users. The VS Code extension received updates for better models, context, and control over code items.
